title: Ejaculation
summary: Ejaculation is when semen is released from the penis, usually at orgasm. Pre-ejaculate (pre-cum) is a small amount of fluid released earlier during arousal.
key_points: Pre-cum can sometimes contain sperm, so withdrawal is not a reliable way to prevent pregnancy.
Orgasm and ejaculation usually happen together but can happen separately.
